Vermont Secretary of State — electionresults.vermont.gov (static JSON)
=====================================================================

Source (fetched 2026-10-27):
  https://static.electionresults.vermont.gov/elections/elections.json
  https://static.electionresults.vermont.gov/elections/67a35c79-05a2-4ae3-a77d-97812256188b.json
  https://static.electionresults.vermont.gov/elections/67a35c79-05a2-4ae3-a77d-97812256188b-f-20260611153112.json
  https://static.electionresults.vermont.gov/elections/67a35c79-05a2-4ae3-a77d-97812256188b-s-20260611153112.json
  https://static.electionresults.vermont.gov/elections/67a35c79-05a2-4ae3-a77d-97812256188b-sn-20260611153112.json
  https://static.electionresults.vermont.gov/elections/67a35c79-05a2-4ae3-a77d-97812256188b-h-20260611153112.json
  https://electionresults.vermont.gov/   (human site)

Election: 2024-11-05 GENERAL ELECTION (guid 67a35c79-05a2-4ae3-a77d-97812256188b).
The election metadata document names the per-section data files (-f federal,
-s statewide, -sn senate, -h house, -cty county, -t town); the timestamp in those
file names is re-generated by the state on every publish, so the adapter always
resolves them through the metadata.

Trimming: the metadata document keeps electionDetails, the federal/stateWide/
senate/house path blocks, lastUpdatedDate and townReportingPercent (the towns
list and report/rss blocks were dropped). The four data documents keep 3 contests
each for federal/statewide, 4 senate contests and 6 house contests, and only the
first 8 town rows ("cs") of each contest; the per-town "cd" vote arrays were
dropped (the parser reads "cs"). Contest metadata (name, district code vf),
candidate rows, write-in rows and vote counts are otherwise byte-for-byte from
the source. Because windowing cuts off towns, totals in fixtures are partial by
construction; the tests assert internal consistency and the leading candidates,
not statewide totals.

2026: the index already lists 2026 GENERAL ELECTION (guid
68d61e96-1d28-4210-8c1d-8e90512ae105, all-zero results) so the adapter discovers
the guid by date; no id is pinned for 2026.
